permit.applies: The foreigner applies to the Commissaire Général des Migrations, by a letter of request the Commissariat approves.
permit.first: An employment contract, a service certificate and the deed of engagement (for an employee), or a tax number and trade registration (for any profit-making activity), and at least six months already spent in Burundi.

sources.title: Commissariat Général des Migrations (Burundi), Services: types de visa octroyés
sources.said: Visa d'établissement ordinaire Documents exigés: Lettre de demande adressée au Commissaire Général des Migrations approuvée Photocopie du passeport Photocopie du visa en cours Photo passeport Avoir passé au moins 6 mois sur le sol burundais Contrat de travail, Attestation de service et Acte … Tarif: 500 USD Validité: 2 ans

blockers.sought: How long the Commissariat or the Labour Ministry takes to decide

tried.institution: migration.gov.bi Services page: no time stated. | Retry 2026-11-01: migration.gov.bi/Services re-read: the establishment visa line gives fee and two-year validity only; no decision time, renewal rule, performer criteria, pay rule or exemption.
tried.official-register: Code du travail 2020 (Loi n° 1/11 du 24 novembre 2020) not reached as an official text; NATLEX entries found give metadata only. | Retry 2026-11-01: natlex.ilo.org (records 97070, 110662, 53736 surfaced by search) answers 403 to this client; assemblee.bi surfaced only the 2020 Code de la protection sociale, not the labour code; no official text of the Code du travail's foreign-worker articles reached.
tried.web-search: 'Burundi permis de travail travailleur étranger ministère de la fonction publique travail emploi code du travail 2020 article'; commercial guides (AfriCarrières, Atlas HXM) only, which cite no article. | Retry 2026-11-01: '"Loi n°1/11 du 24 novembre 2020" code du travail Burundi pdf "permis de travail" étranger'; 'code du travail Burundi 2020 texte intégral pdf "travailleurs étrangers" article "carte de travail" OR "permis de travail" site:bi': commercial guides only (Atlas HXM: two years, renew a month before expiry; AfriCarrières: a temporary category up to 12 months), neither citing an article.
tried.trade-press: La Base Lextenso's 2021 note on the Code (abstract only) gives no procedure. | Retry 2026-11-01: Bulletin de Justice No 81 (May 2025, sostortureburundi.org) cites a 'Loi N°1/11 du 24 novembre 2024' revising the 1993 decree-law, conflicting with the 2020 date; no permit procedure.
